observedFailure: AuthoredAssetContract: three UNiagaraSystem::IsValid failures; load, emitter count, EffectType, user parameter checks passed.

diagnosis.cause: Cold-loaded Niagara packages were not fully initialized and had deferred on-demand compilation. LoadObject plus immediate IsValid is not Niagara readiness; the production EmitImpact IsValid gate also prevented the first component activation from driving lazy readiness.
diagnosis.notTheCause: All three authored packages loaded, contained the expected concrete emitters and parameters, and already referenced /Script/DublinFlight.Default__DublinImpactEffectType. The native EffectType constructor and its significance subobject were valid.
diagnosis.reproduction: GetSystemCompileState(NS_CannonImpact) timed out after 120 seconds before resaving. GetSystemData showed the correct native EffectType before recovery.
diagnosis.recovery: Typed AssetTools.save_assets for exactly the three /Game/FX Niagara systems returned true. This invokes native UNiagaraSystem::PreSave, which calls EnsureFullyLoaded and WaitForCompilationComplete. Afterwards all three reported UpToDate, not compiling, not stale, no compile errors or warnings.
